description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the 'ModifyAttributes' command within a live signal processing context. It provides nested factory interfaces to generate specific response objects (success and error states) and event objects indicating creation or modification of attributes.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: A builder interface for constructing responses and events for the ModifyAttributes command in a live signal processing context.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for generating command response objects such as success responses and error messages related to accessibility and modifiability of attributes.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects indicating attributes creation or modification.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating that attributes have been created, using the command's values.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating that attributes have been modified, using the command's values.

methods.name: attributesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating attributes were not accessible.

methods.name: attributesNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating attributes were not modifiable.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates an AttributesCreated event using the command's values.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates an AttributesModified event using the command's values.
